SELECT leaderboard.user_id, leaderboard.league_id, leaderboard.position, leaderboard.username, leaderboard.email, leaderboard.full_name,
leaderboard.object_key,
leaderboard.total_point, oap.avatar_url FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ulp.total_point DESC, ulp.modified_time IS NULL, ulp.modified_time DESC, ulp.created_time DESC ) AS position, u.id AS user_id, l.id AS league_id, u.username, u.email, u.full_name, f.object_key, ulp.total_point FROM users u JOIN user_learning_progresses ulp ON u.user_learning_progress_id = ulp.id LEFT JOIN files f ON u.avatar_file_id = f.id JOIN leagues l ON l.id = #{leagueId}
WHERE u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ulp.total_point >= l.min_point AND ( l.max_point IS NULL OR ulp.total_point <= l.max_point )) leaderboard LEFT JOIN o_auth_providers oap ON leaderboard.user_id = oap.user_id where leaderboard.position <= 10 ORDER BY leaderboard.position

WITH `user_current_league` AS (SELECT l.id AS league_id, l.min_point, l.max_point FROM users u JOIN user_learning_progresses ulp ON u.user_learning_progress_id = ulp.id JOIN leagues l ON l.min_point <= ulp.total_point AND (l.max_point IS NULL OR l.max_point >= ulp.total_point) WHERE u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.id = #{userId}), leaderboard AS (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ulp.total_point DESC, ulp.modified_time IS NULL, ulp.modified_time DESC, ulp.created_time DESC ) AS position, u.id AS user_id, `user_current_league`.league_id, u.username, u.email, u.full_name, f.object_key, ulp.total_point FROM users u JOIN user_learning_progresses ulp ON u.user_learning_progress_id = ulp.id LEFT JOIN files f ON u.avatar_file_id = f.id CROSS JOIN `user_current_league` WHERE u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ulp.total_point >= `user_current_league`.min_point AND (`user_current_league`.max_point IS NULL OR ulp.total_point <= `user_current_league`.max_point)) SELECT leaderboard.*, oap.avatar_url FROM leaderboard LEFT JOIN o_auth_providers oap ON leaderboard.user_id = oap.user_id WHERE leaderboard.user_id = #{userId}
